top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs two achievements with clean, defensible allocations: Pd-catalyzed C-N coupling (Buchwald, Hartwig) has a clear ligand-controlled mechanistic principle and over 25 years of independent confirmation, and base editing (Liu) converts a defined chemical reaction into a programmable, double-strand-break-free capability with real clinical use. It is a pragmatic rather than thematically unified pairing, and the Kosugi precedent, the 2010 cross-coupling overlap and the 2020 CRISPR proximity must be handled in the citation text, but it is the most mature and best attributed option and the only one with majority support. Perovskites follow for generative potential despite stability questions, then degraders (no approved drug, contested cereblon strand), then phase separation (in vivo evidence still contested); no award is last.
